summary: This clinical trial compares how different types of adapted physical activity affect blood sugar control in people with unbalanced type 2 diabetes. The study plans to include 120 participants aged 18 to 67. The sponsor for this research is Centre d'Etudes et de Recherche pour l'Intensification du Traitement du Diabète. Currently, the trial status is Suspended and it has No phase.

facts.sponsor: Centre d'Etudes et de Recherche pour l'Intensification du Traitement du Diabète
